name: ebaw-soc 2.0.0
description: Description: This record contains the software and data accompanying the article "Evidence-Bound Action Warrants for Agentic Security Operations: A Deterministic Gateway Enforcing Evidence Freshness, Calibrated Confidence, and Response Deadlines" (D. Prokopovych-Tkachenko, submitted to Inventions, MDPI, 2026). Agentic AI is moving security operations centers (SOCs) from alert triage toward autonomous response. An action proposed by a language-model agent may, however, execute after its justification has lapsed: the evidence has gone stale, the confidence was overstated, or the policy changed between planning and execution. Evidence-bound action warrants (EBAW) address this. A deterministic gateway outside the agent admits an action only if five predicates hold: evidence freshness, calibrated confidence above a risk-tiered threshold, quorum-confirmed ledger evidence, a current policy version, and a sufficient response-time budget. It then issues a signed, single-use, expiring warrant, which is revalidated immediately before execution. Version 2.0.0 extends ebaw-sim 1.0.0 and provides: Discrete-event simulation (SimPy). An agentic SOC with six admission policies, eight scenarios and 30 replications on synchronized common random numbers. It reproduces every number, table and data figure of the article bit for bit. Pooled over all runs, the full gateway executed none of 4,276 hallucinated, injected or tampered proposals (confidence-only admission: 77.4%).
